tagline: 雅西卡取景器相机，1985 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1985年推出的取景器相机。配备38mm, f/3.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度Mechanical with a fixed speed of 1/125。感光度100, 200, 400, and 1000 ASA.。

specs.快门: Mechanical with a fixed speed of 1/125
specs.英文简介: Introduced in the market in 1985, the MF-3 was the first Yashica camera produced exclusively in Brazil where 1.2 million units were manufactured.
